purpose: Stress whether concentration robustness survives extreme tranche ratios while separating structural concentration from two-stage integer-share orderability.
rules: concentration grid uses same-deployment current/equal-capital/exhaustive NT$1,000-grid comparison with ratio-specific share flooring
orderability requires every selected name to have at least one FIRST share and at least one ADD share at buyHigh
a ratio may preserve concentration direction yet be execution-infeasible if either tranche rounds to zero shares
guardrails: no BUY/ADD trigger or fill assumptions
feasible ratio range is diagnostic, not a proposed Formal split
